comments.body:
Done in the new commit: the Vertex AI default is now `gemini-3.8-live` too. Vertex's model-versions page lists it as the replacement for `gemini-live-2.5-flash-native-audio`, which retires on 2026-12-13. The default-model test now checks both APIs; the Google realtime tests (70) and ruff pass.

This change was prepared by an AI agent (Claude) working for the PR author.
